description: Whether a captured document links to the right Portal/BC record (QA-04): one GET-only SharePoint capture of QCQA '/AOs/2026 - AOs' (scans OCR-read locally), one GET-only BC capture of the entity sets the host captures (every pinned company), and, when the Portal is served (optional PLX_WORKBENCH_API_URL / PLX_WORKBENCH_API_KEY), a GET-only Portal mirror of the relations bound to the record types the projected documents can use: of each document type held, the relations a reference of a kind its documents name is looked up in and, when they name one, the relations its comparisons reach (portal_mirror.relations, of portal_mirror.relations_declared for every class; unbound when the documents alone were not projected), the lookups' relations first, three at a time (--portal-workers 3, as mirror.full_coverage and ontology.projection read the same API); all projected together into the check's temporary host state (scripts/eval_document_fields_live.py --links). Every reference of every projected document-field object (a profile's refers_to field, else the identifier grammar's reading, keyed by its kind) is read through the served host (plx.around over the class's mention link types) and gets one outcome: linked_one by tier, ambiguous (two or more candidate records, never one picked), withheld, no_record (every served carrier relation of its kind was captured whole) or source_not_captured (some was not); for each linked_one over the class's attests link, every declared comparison is agree / conflict / not_comparable (operating/attested_conflicts.agreement), and each not_comparable is counted under one cause (agreement_not_comparable, summing to agreement.not_comparable, and not_comparable_by_field per profile and field: a gap reason _compare reported, missing_in_record, document_not_stated, record_event_absent, no_record_reached, record_property_not_served, record_source_lacks_property, document_blank, record_value_absent, no_entry_compared, document_value_unread, different_measure, else unclassified). links_measured (linked_one + ambiguous + no_record: references a captured record source answered) must be at least 1, so a run where every reference is source_not_captured, withheld or not_linkable measures no link and fails. requests_sent counts the SharePoint capture's, the BC capture's and the Portal mirror's GETs (portal_mirror.requests_sent). cross_scope_corroborated (a reference whose candidates span two BC companies or two records yet linked to one, or above lead) and leaks (edges, objects and linked references the served host gives a principal granted the files but no record source) must be 0. The run holds a total budget (--budget-seconds 1500 under the 1800 s timeout): each read phase (SharePoint, then the Portal, then BC) gets at most what the budget leaves after a reserve sized from this run's own cost and the estimate that follows the read (reserve.estimate_seconds), measured in two projections, each served (the state's own projection set aside and put back, also at the start of the next run when one was killed mid-estimate) with up to 4 of its documents measured for both readers: the document sources alone, whole (the documents the run measures, reserve.documents, and the identifiers they reference), and with a 1-in-16 stride of every other relation's rows plus every row naming a referenced identifier, the dropped rows never decoded; reserve.projection_estimate_seconds: the documents' projection seconds, plus the sample's own reading of every row once (its filter never), plus what the kept rows added beyond the sample's own seconds, scaled to all the rows; reserve.measure_seconds_per_document: the mean measurement seconds of the documents measured over the second projection, each over the records it links (measured, not scaled); reserve.measure_estimate_seconds: that times reserve.documents; the estimate's own seconds, the projection and the measurement held with a margin), measured again after every read and after the last BC slice; BC reads in slices that leave the projection their reads add room (reserve.bc_slices), and measurement always measures the first document and stops reading further ones at the budget; a run the budget cut (a SharePoint root left time_budget, a record source given no time, or documents left unmeasured) is incomplete (reason budget, with the phases cut and the documents measured and unmeasured) and never ok; a sample projection that raised stops the reads and is incomplete (reason sample_projection_failed, cut reserve, reserve.failed its error code). Counts, booleans and enums only; no names, paths, ids, identifiers, values or text.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it; its test is injected-transport (tests/test_eval_document_fields_live.py runs --links over the in-process FakeDrive and FakeBc with two companies that reuse numbers, no Portal, and checks this spec's expectations on that output). Captures live only in {tmp}/state and are deleted with the check's temporary directory. With neither BC records nor a complete Portal relation the run is blocked no_record_source (blocked_when), never a pass and never no_record; a BC or Portal part that fails is one blocked_upstream entry and every reference whose kind it carries stays source_not_captured. Unverified live assumptions: the AO scans' OCR text names AO, bulk-lot and sales-order identifiers the grammar reads (ao_code, batch_code, so_number: carried by Portal relations only, so they link only when the Portal is served); how many link, and to how many records, is measured here, never assumed. The live audience is an example (examples/document_links_audience.live-check.json). Time (2026-10-12): the first live pass took 3089 s at the old phase budgets (SharePoint about 270 s, as ontology.document_fields_sharepoint measures for the same scope; BC cut at 1800 s with 73 of 108 units; the Portal at most 900 s; the projection and measurement the rest, about 120 s), so 1.5 x its duration never fit a daily run's budget left. Now 1500 s total: SharePoint at most 600 s, the Portal at most 600 s, BC the rest (at most 900 s). The 2026-10-13 run (reads 1112 s, projection 403.5 s, 6 documents unmeasured) showed a fixed 300 s projection reserve too small, so the reserve is measured in the run (scripts/eval_document_fields_live.py, reserve: a timed 1-in-16 sample projection scaled to every record; BC read in slices sized by the projection seconds its reads add); the 2026-10-13 review measured that sample about 3x over the projection on the injected world (it read every record and scaled the read by 16), so a source now strides its own queries; phase_seconds records each phase's measured seconds, reserve the last estimate (compare with phase_seconds.project). The 2026-10-13 daily run (f679ac8c) cut measure with 3 of 6 documents unmeasured: the stride projected none of them, so the measurement reserve was 0 s while each took about 22 s once BC and Portal records were linked; the measurement is now reserved from the documents the capture holds at the cost measured in the run. The 2026-10-13 review of that change: the per-document cost came from the first document only (with a 0.5 s floor far below the live ~22 s), the reserve counted every captured content rather than the documents measured, the estimate's own seconds had no margin, a SIGKILL mid-estimate could leave the sample at the projection path, and the records' added measurement cost was the stride's scaled x16; now the reserve is the documents projected times the mean of up to 4 measured over a sample holding the records they name, all three held with the margin, and the state's projection is restored on the next start. BC finishing fewer units leaves more references source_not_captured, a typed outcome, not a cut; a later run in the same runner session reuses the units bc.capture_incremental completed (topped_up); a run on a reused state directory that left BC unfinished keeps its session start there (links-fresh-since, 24 h), so the next run resumes the paused units, never stale. A complete AO library across runs needs a persistent state directory (later_ask live-host-persistent-state-dir); until then a budget cut is a typed incomplete, never a pass. The 2026-10-15 daily run (capture 318 s, Portal mirror 486 s, projection 460 s) recorded reserve.projection_estimate_seconds 1210, and the 2026-10-16 run on main 3c9d0a2bc (capture 261 s, Portal mirror 601 s at its 600 s cap with 21 of 25 relations complete, one relation read at a time, reserve 62 s, projection 319 s against an estimate of 813 s, measure 111 s) likewise, so BC got 0 s within the 1500 s budget and the run was incomplete: the sample's own time (reading every row, and testing each stepped-over row for a referenced identifier) was scaled by the stride with what the kept rows add. Now the sample times itself (reading once, the filter not at all; on the injected world at 500 to 32000 BC items the estimate is within about 20% of the projection, where it was about 12x over), its filter is set lookups, and the Portal mirror reads three relations at a time and is bound to the relations the captured documents' types and kinds can use (an AO-packet-only capture skips the 6 purchase-order and shipment relations of the 25). 2026-10-16: 14 links measured gave agreement 1 agree, 1 conflict, 46 not_comparable, causes unrecorded; measure_seconds_per_document 1.3 against about 18 s measured (the sample holds the linked records, not the records their comparison paths walk), so the measurement reserve is short and is held only by the margin; the run now records them by cause. Unverified live: whether the bound mirror and the corrected reserve leave BC time within 1500 s at RESERVE_MARGIN 0.5 (1.5 x (estimate + projection + measurement) after reads of about 800 s may still exceed it); the next daily run's phase_seconds and reserve answer it.
